evidence_caveat: ⚠️ SCREENER, not a forecast. These candidates meet the published gates on daily bars, regular session. No component of the ranking has shown predictive value out-of-sample. Nothing here is a forecast or trading advice.
research_score_caveat: 🔬 Research score — NOT VALIDATED. Retained as a Phase 2 baseline. It does not separate outcomes within a bucket out-of-sample (MH OR 0.991, p=0.947). Do not read it as a ranking.

exit_reason_notes.breakout_failed: Closed back below the 20-day resistance level it broke out over at alert time. Measured to fire on the first session in most cases (651 of 1,545 replayed exits, at a median peak of 0.00%): an overly sensitive rule, not a confirmed breakout failure.
exit_reason_notes.momentum_stalled: Relative volume (20-day) stayed below 1.5 for 3 consecutive sessions.
exit_reason_notes.stop_atr: Closed more than 2 × ATR(14) below the reference price. In the Phase 1 replay this condition was true 116 times but fired first only 31 — faster rules usually pre-empt it, and its priority ordering is unvalidated.
exit_reason_notes.timeout: Held for 20 sessions without another exit firing. This exit never fired in 1,545 replayed exits (the longest position ran 17 sessions), so a timeout here is itself unusual and worth a closer look.
